meta.note: Dining options are NOT included in holiday package budgets. They are shown as nearby suggestions only. Price bands: $ = quick/affordable ($8-18pp), $$ = casual family dining ($18-35pp), $$$ = premium ($35-60+pp). Opening hours may vary — check before visiting.

venues.name: Rice Boi
venues.notes: Lively Asian street food eatery at The Wharf. Loaded baos, bao burgers, dumplings, loaded fries. Share plates, communal seating, loud music. Kids love the flavours.

venues.name: Fisheries on the Spit
venues.notes: Famous takeaway fish and chips at the Mooloolaba Spit. Eat on the harbour wall watching boats. Fresh local seafood, generous portions, picnic tables. Family classic.

venues.name: Guzman y Gomez
venues.notes: Fast, fresh Mexican at The Wharf. Burrito bowls, nachos, kids' mini burritos. Quick lunch or dinner when you can't be bothered cooking.

venues.name: The Shack
venues.notes: Relaxed beachside dining at The Wharf — fish tacos, burgers, seafood platters, cocktails. Waterfront deck, live music. Very family-accepting early evening.

venues.name: Multiple Choice Eatery
venues.notes: All-day breakfast and burgers in Mooloolaba — big portions, generous sides, good coffee. Affordable family brunch spot.

venues.name: Crumb Fiend Bakery
venues.notes: Artisan bakery and cafe — excellent pastries, sourdough, pies, sandwiches, great coffee. Perfect for family breakfast or lunch.

venues.name: Summer Salt Pizza
venues.notes: Wood-fired pizza at Cotton Tree — fresh ingredients, generous toppings, eat-in or takeaway. Family-friendly, casual, open late.

venues.name: Hibiscus Cafe & Restaurant
venues.notes: Beachfront cafe-restaurant at Cotton Tree — seafood, burgers, big breakfasts. Outdoor deck overlooking the river. Kids' menu available.

venues.name: Kings Beach Tavern
venues.notes: Family-friendly tavern near Kings Beach — massive bistro, kids' play area, schnitzel nights, seafood platters. Cheap kids' meals. Surf club alternative.

venues.name: Blue Angel Restaurant
venues.notes: Caloundra institution — fresh seafood, fish and chips, prawns, calamari. Waterfront on Golden Beach, casual, Bring Your Own (BYO) wine. Been serving families for decades.

venues.name: Ambrosia Burger Bar
venues.notes: Gourmet burgers and loaded fries in central Caloundra — creative patties, dirty fries, milkshakes. Casual, fast, filling. Kids demolish the mini burgers.

venues.name: Moffat Beach Brewing Co
venues.notes: Craft brewery with excellent family-friendly bistro — wood-fired pizza, burgers, share plates. Outdoor beer garden, kids can run around. Ocean views.

venues.name: Coolum Beach Surf Club
venues.notes: Classic surf club on Coolum Beach — beachfront dining, steak, parmy, fish & chips, kids' meals ~$12. Unbeatable views with sand at your feet.

venues.name: My Place Restaurant
venues.notes: Local favourite in Coolum — burgers, seafood, big salads, generous portions. Friendly staff, casual, popular with families. Dinner bookings recommended.

venues.name: Moo Cliff Cafe
venues.notes: Casual beach cafe at Point Arkwright — coffee, breakfast rolls, acai bowls, light lunches. Grab a coffee and walk the coastal track.

venues.name: Sakana Japanese
venues.notes: Quality Japanese restaurant at The Wharf — sushi, sashimi, teriyaki, tempura. Fresh fish, good value lunch specials. Waterfront dining with harbour views.

venues.name: The Bavarian Sunshine Coast
venues.notes: German beer hall at Sunshine Plaza — massive pretzels, schnitzels, sausages, share platters. Lively, loud, very family-friendly. Indoor play area.

venues.name: Noosa Pizza
venues.notes: Wood-fired pizza trailer at Noosa Farmers Market (Sundays) — sourdough base, creative toppings. Grab a pizza and eat on the grass. Kids love it.

venues.name: Domino's Pizza (various)
venues.notes: Cheap pizza for the night you can't be bothered. $5 value pizzas, delivery or pickup. Multiple locations across Sunshine Coast.
